info.title: LLDP_Neighbor
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

chassis_id.description:
Reference Resource: [LLDP_Neighbor](#/LLDP_Neighbor)
The Chassis ID identifies the chassis containing the IEEE 802 LAN station associated with the transmitting LLDP agent.

dcbx_cee_status.description: Key-value pairs of CEE DCBx state-machine variables.

application_tlv_error.description: Indicates that an error occurred during the Application  Protocol TLV configuration exchange with the peer.

application_tlv_operating_version.description: The operating version for the DCBx Application Protocol TLV.

pfc_tlv_error.description: Indicates that an error occurred during the Priority Flow  Control configuration exchange with the peer.

pfc_tlv_operating_version.description: The local DCBx Priority Flow Control TLV operating version.

pg_tlv_error.description: Indicates that an error occurred during the Priority  Group TLV configuration exchange with the peer.

pg_tlv_operating_version.description: The operating version for the DCBx Priority Group TLV.

interface.description:
Reference Resource: [LLDP_Neighbor](#/LLDP_Neighbor)
Reference to the interface on which the LLDP frame is received.

mac_addr.description: The MAC address that uniquely identifies the IEEE 802 LAN station associated to the chassis of the neighboring LLDP agent. This MAC address is stored in the canonical format that includes six groups of two hexadecimal digits separated by colons e.g. 01:23:45:AB:CD:EF.

med_network_policy.description: Set of Network policy entries from the connected remote device.

dscp.description: The DSCP value to be used to provide Diffserv node behavior for the specified application type.

priority.description: The Layer 2 priority to be used for the specified application type.

tagged.description: Indicates whether the specified application type is using tagged or untagged vlan.

unknown_policy.description: Indicates that an Endpoint Device wants to explicitly advertise that this policy is required by the device, but is currently unknown.

vlanID.description: The VLAN identifier (VID) for the port.

neighbor_info.description: Key-value pairs of neighbor's port info as discovered by LLDP.

associated_poe_tlv_for_pd.description: Indicates the negotiated POE TLV type.

chassis_capability_available.description: The chassis capabilities field contains a bit-map of the capabilities that define the primary function(s) of the system. A binary one in the associated bit indicates the existence of that capability. Individual systems may indicate more than one implemented functional capability (for example, both a bridge and router capability).

chassis_capability_enabled.description: The enabled capabilities field contains a bit map of the primary functions of the system. A binary one in a bit position  indicates that the function is currently enabled.

chassis_description.description: The chassis description field contains an alpha-numeric string that is the textual description of the network entity. It include the full name and version identification of the hardware type software operating system, and networking software.

chassis_id_subtype.description: The chassis ID subtype field contains an integer value indicating the basis for the chassis ID entity listed in the chassis ID field.

chassis_index.description: The interface index value used to identify the chassis.

chassis_name.description: The system name field contains an alpha-numeric string that indicates the administratively assigned name.

chassis_ttl.description: The Time To Live TLV indicates the number of seconds that the recipient LLDP agent is to regard the information associated with this MSAP identifier to be valid.

eee_wake_time_fallback.description: The peer's EEE FALLBACK wake time in microseconds.

eee_wake_time_rx.description: The peer's EEE RX wake time in microseconds.

eee_wake_time_rx_echo.description: The peer's EEE RX_ECHO wake time in microseconds.

eee_wake_time_tx.description: The peer's EEE TX wake time in microseconds.

eee_wake_time_tx_echo.description: The peer's EEE TX_ECHO wake time in microseconds.

macphy_mau_type.description: Common enumeration values for repeater and interface MAU jack types.

med_capabilities_enabled.description: The med capabilities enabled field contains a bit map indicating the MED organizationally defined set of LLDP TLVs that are transmitted by the remote system. A binary one in a bit position indicates that corresponding TLV is received.

med_capabilities_supported.description: The med capabilities supported field contains a bit map indicating the MED organizationally defined set of LLDP TLVs whose transmission is possible by the remote system. A binary one in a bit position indicates that corresponding TLV is supported.

med_device_class.description: This filed indicates the Device Class as advertised by the remote device connected to the interface.

mgmt_iface_list.description: A comma-separated list of management interface IDs.

mgmt_iface_oid_list.description: A comma-separated list of management interfaces OID.

mgmt_iface_subtype_list.description: A comma-separated list of management interfaces subtype.

mgmt_ip_list.description: A comma-separated list of management IP addresses.

pd_4pid.description: It indicates whether the remote powered device (PD) supports powering on both modes simultaneously

pd_autoclass_request.description: It indicates whether the remote PD is requesting an autoclass request

pd_dot3_ext_tlv_advertised.description: Indicates whether PD has advertised an 802.3bt TLV.

pd_dot3_tlv_advertised.description: Indicates whether PD has advertised an 802.3at TLV.

pd_med_tlv_advertised.description: Indicates whether PD has advertised an MED TLV.

pd_power_down_request.description: Indicates that the remote PD has requested that it to be powered down.

pd_power_down_time.description: Indicates the time in seconds until when the PD is requesting for PSE to not deliver power.  If the value is 0, it means the PSE will not deliver power until the PD the physically disconnected  and reconnected again.

pd_powered_status.description: In 802.3af and 802.3at standards, the power controller on the PSE uses two of the four pairs of wires in the RJ45 connector to supply power to a power controller on the PD. With 802.3bt standard, the controller on the PSE uses all four pairs. On the PD side, there can either be single power controller, or two distinct power controllers connected to each of the two pairs, and each of the two controllers would negotiate and draw power independently from the PSE.  This indicates the powering status of remote powered device.

pids_len_list.description: A comma-separated list of length of protocol ID names.

pids_name_list.description: A comma-separated list of protocol ID name.

port_description.description: The port description field shall contain an alpha-numeric string that indicates the port's description.

port_id_subtype.description: The port ID subtype field shall contain an integer value indicating the basis for the identifier that is listed  in the port ID field.

port_lastchange.description: Time (posix seconds) of last change of values.

port_lastupdate.description: Time (posix seconds) of last update received.

port_protocol.description: Protocol used to get this port (LLDP).

port_pvid.description: The port VLAN identifier field shall contain the VLAN ID for the bridge port as defined in 8.4.4 of IEEE Std 802.1Q.

power_allocated.description: The power allocated by power-sourcing equipment, measured in Watts, as reported by the powered device (PD) via 802.3at TLV fields.

power_allocated_pair_a.description: The power allocated by power-sourcing equipment on pair-A of this interface, measured in Watts.

power_allocated_pair_b.description: The power allocated by power-sourcing equipment on pair-B of this interface, measured in Watts.

power_class.description: Applicable to power-over-ethernet powered devices (PD). This is the classification advertised by the remote PD.

power_class_pair_a.description: This is applicable to power-over-ethernet powered devices (PD) compliant with 803.2bt standard, and specifically to dual-signature PDs. This is the classification of remote PD on pair-A of this interface.

power_class_pair_b.description: This is applicable to power-over-ethernet powered devices (PD) compliant with 803.2bt standard, and specifically to dual-signature PDs. This is the classification of remote PD on pair-B of this interface.

power_devicetype.description: This indicates that whether the remote device conected to this interface is a power-sourcing equipment (PSE) or a powered device (PD).

power_paircontrol.description: Describes the capability of controlling the power pairs functionality to switch pins for sourcing power.  `true`  - the device has the capability to control the power pairs. `false` - the PSE Pinout alternative used cannot be controlled through the           PethPsePortAdminEnable attribute.

power_pairs.description: Describes the power pairs in use.  `signal` - the signal pairs only are in use. `spare`  - the spare pairs only are in use.

power_pd_load.description: It indicates whether the load of the remote dual-signature PD is electrically isolated  A true value indicates that remote PD is dual-signature and power demand on Mode A and Mode B are electrically isolated. A false value indicates that remote PD is single-signature and power demand on Mode A and Mode B are not electrically isolated

power_priority.description: Power priority advertised by the powered device (PD) via 802.3at TLV fields.

power_requested.description: The power requested by powered device (PD), measured in Watts. This is reported by the PD via 802.3at TLV fields.

power_requested_pair_a.description: The power requested by powered device on pair-A of this interface, measured in Watts.

power_requested_pair_b.description: The power requested by powered device on pair-B of this interface, measured in Watts.

power_source.description: Indicates the source of power on the powered device (PD), as reported by the PD via 802.3at TLV fields.

power_supported.description: The power supported by the powered device, measured in Watts.

ppvids_cap_list.description: A comma-separated list of port and protocol vlan capablity.

ppvids_ppvid_list.description: A comma-separated list of port and protocol vlan IDs.

pse_maximum_available_power.description: For dual-signature PDs, this value refers to the total amount of power available at the remote powere device, measured in Watts.

remote_index.description: A monotonically increasing index value which uniquely identifies a particular remote system.

vlan_id_list.description: A comma-separated list of vlan IDs.

vlan_name_list.description: A comma-separated list of vlan names.

oui.description: The OUI identifier received in the organizational TLV.

oui_data.description: The Octet string (Raw bytes) in the organizational TLV in the form 0x...

oui_subtype.description: The OUI subtype identifier received in the organizational TLV.

port_id.description:
Reference Resource: [LLDP_Neighbor](#/LLDP_Neighbor)
The Port ID identifies the port component of the MSAP identifier associated with the transmitting LLDP agent.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Interface](#/Interface)
The interface name. For non-bonded ports, the interface name is the same as the associated port name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
